comparison_to_phenomenological.note: Gradient screening gives f≈1; suppression is from α_M running in full hi_class

description: Gradient-dependent screened halo-model: f(g) replaces S(ρ). Cosmic halos have g << g_t, so f ≈ 1 and the halo model is essentially unscreened.  The ~0.55 growth suppression comes from α_M running in hi_class, not from environmental gradient screening.
scope: Simplified assigned mass-function/bias surrogate for the EdS diagnostic; not a native nonlinear perturbation prediction

screening.note: g_vir << g_t for all cosmological halos; f ≈ 1 (unscreened)
